Market Value Definition
Market value means the most probable price which a property should bring in a competitive
and open market under all conditions requisite to a fair sale, thebuyer and seller each acting
prudently and knowledgeably, and assuming the price is not affected by undue stimulus.
Implicit in this definition is the consummation of a sale as of a specified date and the
passing of title from seller to buyer under conditions whereby:
1.buyer and seller are typically motivated;
2.both parties are well informed orwell advised and acting in what they consider their
own best interests;
3.a reasonable time is allowed for exposure in the open market;
4.payment is made in terms of cash in U.S. dollars or in terms of financial
arrangements comparable thereto; and

special or creative financing or sales concessions granted by anyone associated with

CITYDATA
Geographic Location:
Cheyenne is located in the southeastern corner of Wyoming, ten miles north of the
Colorado border and 40 miles west of the Nebraska border.The city is located at a major
division point for the Union Pacific Railroad and at the juncture of interstate highways I-
80 and I-25.
Physical Factors:
Cheyenne is located on rolling rangelands at analtitude of approximately 6,100feet above
sea level.The soil is typically heavy clay with some sandy loam, which usually requires
enrichment to be productive.Cheyenne has an average annual precipitation of 15.1 inches.
Cheyenne has an extensive Greenway network of wide sidewalks along open spaces or
landscape buffers that is unique for the region and a significant amenity in the warm months
for recreation and transport.
Demographics:
Cheyenne is the largest city in Wyoming with a 2020 population of 65,132.The bulk of
the federal government offices in Wyoming are located in Cheyenne, which has helped
stabilize the economy and population in Laramie County.Population growthfor Laramie
County from 2000 to 2019 averaged about 1.0% per year.Laramie County Community
College (LCCC)is in Cheyenne. Cheyenne is in the top quartile for percent of population
with associates degrees, but in the bottom quartile forbachelor's degrees.In 2019 the state
legislature approved a bill to allow community colleges to do some four-year degrees.This
should significantly increase the education level in Cheyenne in the long run.
